SubLevelDesc: Give 2 subtrahends without borrow. Only paise is 2 digit number.
Expression:
$majorunit = '₹'
$minorunit = 'paise'
$mulFactor = 100
$opnmjr1 = random(0)
$opnmjr2 = random(0)
$opnmnr1 = random([50, 60, 70, 80, 90])
$opnmnr2 = random([10, 20, 30, 40])
$nums = [toNumber($mulFactor), toNumber($opnmjr1), toNumber($opnmjr2), toNumber($opnmnr1), toNumber($opnmnr2)]
$borrow = iff((($opnmnr1 - $opnmnr2))<0, $mulFactor, 0)
$ansmnr = (($opnmnr1 + $borrow) - $opnmnr2) % $mulFactor
$ansmjr = ($opnmjr1 - $borrow/$mulFactor) - $opnmjr2
Description: Tests the concept of subtraction of money.
Subject: Other
